summary: This bill requires the Secretary of Agriculture to be a member of the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States (CFIUS) for transactions involving agricultural land, biotechnology, or the agriculture industry, and mandates CFIUS review of agricultural land transactions involving foreign persons from China, North Korea, Russia, or Iran.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses on restricting foreign investment in U.S. agricultural land and related industries from specific adversarial countries. This is a protectionist measure aimed at safeguarding domestic agricultural assets from foreign control, aligning with policies that restrict free trade.
